Script.name: init
enableMSDP
Script.script:
function SlothMap.enableMSDP() sendMSDP("REPORT","CHARACTER_LOCATION") end
if msdp and not msdp.CHARACTER_LOCATION then SlothMap.enableMSDP() end

Script.name: setRoom
Script.script:
function SlothMap.setRoom() local roomNum = tonumber(msdp.CHARACTER_LOCATION.ROOM.VNUM) centerview(roomNum) end
if not SlothMap.handlerId then SlothMap.handlerId = registerAnonymousEventHandler("msdp.CHARACTER_LOCATION",SlothMap.setRoom) end

Script.name: doSpeedWalk
Script.script:
-- implement doSpeedWalk function doSpeedWalk() local sep = getCommandSeparator()
local run = ""
for i, dir in pairs(speedWalkDir) do local roomNum = tonumber(speedWalkPath[i]) local currentRoom if i ~= 1 then currentRoom = tonumber(speedWalkPath[i - 1]) else currentRoom = SlothMap.getCurrentRoomNum() end
-- Work with doors -- local doors = getDoors(currentRoom) for doorDir, doorType in pairs(doors) do if doorDir == dir then local doorName = getRoomUserData(currentRoom, "door_" .. doorDir) if doorType == 3 then run = run .. 'unlock ' .. doorDir .. sep run = run .. 'pick ' .. doorDir .. sep run = run .. 'pick ' .. doorDir .. sep end run = run .. 'open ' .. doorName .. ' ' .. doorDir .. sep end end run = run .. dir ..sep end
send(run) end
